baselineDonors.evidenceAsRecorded: Components and blueprint sections 46-48 and 51-52 record actual pinned OpenClaw utility, Gateway/device/execution, retry-timing, ACP-helper, placement-binding and CUA-policy imports/adaptations. Exact imported and destination paths, modifications and rights boundaries are in third_party/components.json and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. GM-13 ACP helpers bind metadata to already-admitted GM-11 runs and report read-only installation health; they do not provide ACP transport, patch execution, automatic resume or governed availability. L5 timing imports provide no retry runner or dispatch authority. Placement adaptation binds current owner/node/generation to existing backends and adds no remote executor or donor state store. CUA is assessment-only with nativeAvailable=false and no native binary. The L3 kernel in server/agentLoop.ts is LiOS-owned, with no agent-core loop source import: pinned agent-core loop/admission/steering mechanisms informed cancellation/admission ordering, while LiOS independently owns goal-plan-act-inspect-revise, enforced step/AI/revision budgets, durable ledger events, exact approval pause/resume and outcome-unknown handling. At this commit OpenClaw browser source is not imported; the donor-first L12 disposition selects bounded UTF-8 diagnostics for direct import when provenance lands, adapts lifecycle/page-ownership/navigation/framed-transport mechanisms, and declines donor control/profile/auth/storage/plugin authorities. Browser/computer native execution, complete coding transport, remote nodes, memory/skills breadth and release qualification remain open; no listed tests or Shipping Point acceptance are implied.

It does not replace the scored Global Instrument Master name/identifier resolver; no P5 identity state is delegated to it. Deferred, not rejected: reconsider for bulk reconciliation of provider catalogs / holdings imports (S4) behind the same P5 candidate contract, with ambiguity surfaced by LiOS, after the labelled no-ticker corpus (roadmap 0.0.13 F) exists.
